descriptions.notStarted: To help her decide between Maplemas and Versalmas, Little Suzy wants me to go talk to Maple Claws.  I'm sure she's back in town now in Happyville.
descriptions.inProgress: To help Little Suzy decide between Maplemas and Versalmas, I spoke to Maple Claws about Suzy's dilemma.  Maple Claws listened and asked me to deliver a message to Suzy.  I should talk to her in a bit.
descriptions.completed: Maple Claws gave me a message for Suzy: that as long as she remembers the essence of the Maplemas Spirit, it doesn't really matter what holiday traditions she chooses to follow this year.  I should return to Suzy with Maple Claws' message once I've also spoken to O-Pongo.
